```plato
    //==
    // # Hash to number
    //
    // The low 24 bits are taken so the value is non-negative whatever the sign
    // convention of the host's shift, and 24 bits is exactly the mantissa a
    // single-precision backend can carry without rounding two hashes together.

    // The hash as a number in [0, 1).
    HashToUnit(h: Integer): Number
        => h.BitwiseAnd(16777215).ToNumber / 16777216.0;
```
